newsitem.title: USA: Six tons of cocaine, marijuana seized in Caribbean.
newsitem.headline: Six tons of cocaine, marijuana seized in Caribbean.

text.p: U.S., Haitian and Puerto Rican agents seized more than six tons of cocaine and marijuana and arrested eight suspected smugglers in Caribbean waters during the past five days, the U.S. Coast Guard said on Monday.
The U.S. Coast Guard snared 1,600 pounds (750 kg) of baled cocaine after chasing down a speedboat with a helicopter and cutter about five miles (8 km) south of Haiti.
Five suspected smugglers beached the boat and escaped into a forest but authorities found the drugs when they searched the vessel, the Coast Guard said.

On Saturday, a U.S. Customs aircraft spotted a speedboat near Vieques, Puerto Rico. A cutter stopped the boat and found no drugs on board, but a search of surrounding waters turned up about 800 pounds (360 kg) of cocaine that had been tossed overboard, the Coast Guard said.
The two crewmen were in the custody of U.S. Customs.
On Friday, a speedboat chased down near Pinones, Puerto Rico was carrying thirteen bales of cocaine totalling about 935 pounds (425 kg).

And on Thursday, a Coast Guard cutter stopped a 50-foot (15-meter) speedboat in Haitian waters. The boat was loaded down with 9,000 pounds (4,100 kg) of marijuana and 50 pounds (22 kg) of cocaine. Six crewmen, the boat and its contraband were turned over to Haitian authorities in Port-au-Prince.

The Coast Guard said Operation Frontier Shield -- a U.S.-led exercise to interdict drugs and refugees in the Caribbean -- , had resulted in seizure of more than 22,000 pounds (10,000 kg) of cocaine since its start on Oct 1.
